cues: A stimulus pushes it to the threshold, minus fifty five.
Sodium gates fly open, sodium floods in, and the inside shoots to plus thirty five: depolarisation.
Then sodium gates close, potassium gates open, potassium rushes out, and the inside goes negative again, overshooting to minus eighty before settling.
